name: config-sync
description: Two-way sync and diff of terminal config files between local environment and ccNovaTerm project. Manages 8 config files (including Yazi) + 2 reference docs (docs/*.md). Unified diff with hash-based pre-check for low-token comparison. Progressive disclosure architecture with 7 reference files. Auto-protects proxy settings; supports ~/.configsyncignore for custom exclusions.
